about: Shapes carried by vtl-carry-area from measured area functions to a 2.4 speaker (src/carry.rs; research/VOCALWIND_LANGUAGES.md, "Rhotic vowels"): each one's 19 parameters, the rms of its log areas' differences from the measured over equal stretches of the tract (src/carry.rs INTERVALS), and its resonances below 5 kHz in the 2.4 engine -- the measured area function on its own length and laid on the carried shape's, the carried shape's own -- beside those its source predicted and measured. Where `tuned` is given, its parameters are the carried shape's tuned (its first resonances brought to the laid area function's on the engine, languages/carry.json `tune`), the carried shape's own beside them.

measured.about: MI's /r/ in 40 real words (Table II: consonantal and syllabic), at F3's lowest

predicted.about: VTCALCS's resonances (S. Maeda's time-domain model) of the measured shape, as the paper computes them

shapes.sublingual: inserted into the front cavity at its opening (Espy-Wilson et al. 2000, experiment 3)

source.authors: C. Y. Espy-Wilson, S. E. Boyce, M. Jackson, S. Narayanan & A. Alwan
source.data_from: A. Alwan, S. Narayanan & K. Haker 1997, 'Toward articulatory-acoustic models for liquid approximants based on MRI and EPG data. Part II. The rhotics', JASA 101(2) 1078-1089, doi:10.1121/1.417972
source.title: Acoustic modeling of American English /r/
